component: Thread-pane sort menu state and dispatch

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The main View menu and header sort menu call the same state helper. Menu values use nsMsgViewSortType keys, while command dispatch finds the matching column sortKey and sends its column id to sortThreadPane. The helper reads DBViewWrapper state and updates one checked value in each of the type, direction and grouping groups. Direct tests cover four named keys and selected direction/grouping transitions; native sorting and all-column behavior were not executed.
title: Both sort menus share native sort keys and map them back to column ids
